title: QZarCalamityCraft
description: New swords New armor New mobs New equipmnet New Structures!
body:
The QzarCalamityCraft. Mode adds New Monsters, New Bosses, New items, New dimensions, New Structures, New Ores, New swords and equipment. In total 447 Mode elements will be more in future.


New 20 Mobs Evil eye, Shield Skeleton, Lasvoss, Ancient mage, Good Ghast, Corrupted Zombie, Flying Corrupted Zombie, Crab, Warrior, Fire entity, Torpedo Eye, Monolith(not spawning), EnderAngry, Enn, RadiationBobr, NotABotWith100Percent, MechaEvilEye, 4 variant of Pirates.


New 23 Bosses World Ghast(1 Phase), WitherPrototype(1 Phase), Ctulhu Eye(2 Phase) Mecha Ctulhu Eye(1 Phase), Spagma Eye and Retinazar Eye(2 Phase), Romb Of Tomb(3 Phase), Crab Monster(1 Phase), The Fallen(1 Phase), Bota(1 Phase), Ultimate Cosmo(4 Phases), King Lasvoss(3 Phases), The Lunar Architect(1 Phase), The Lunar Defender(1 Phase), The Lunar Head(2 Phase), The Lunar Zender(1 Phase), The Lunar Drill(1 Phase), The Lunar(7 Phases), True Mage(1 Phase), Shipmaster(2Phase), Lavader(1 Phase), IAMGOLEM(1 Phase), Jagando(W.I.P).


New 2 Dimension The Moon and The Lavos.


New Items Boss spawners, Teleporter, The fallen totem, Boss drops, Crab Claws, Gun, Flame essence, Crabs Rib, BigBrain, Bestiary and more.


New Ores Orangenium, Violetium, Voidlyt, Uranium, Platinum, Latist.
New Equipment Orangenuim, Violetim, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Hoe, Sword


New 4 Armor Platinum Armor, Violetium Armor, Orangenium Armor, Eye Armor.


New Swords Orangenium Sword, Violetium Sword, Eye Sword, Ghast Sword, Double Energy Sword, Voidlyt Sword, Crab Claw, Void Sword, Danger Stick, Claw, Fire Sword, Fallen Sword.


Your adventure will be more dangerous with QzarCalamityCraft. You might be very strong if you would beat all bosses. Would You?
